name: What preparation is needed before installing new kitchen wall tiles?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before installing new kitchen wall tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a successful tile installation. This includes ensuring the wall surface is clean, dry, flat, and free from grease or debris. Any existing wallpaper or loose paint must be removed, and significant imperfections or holes should be repaired and leveled. Depending on the substrate, a primer or backer board may be necessary to ensure proper adhesion and moisture resistance. We handle all necessary surface preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before tile installation, walls must be clean, dry, flat, and free of imperfections. Existing wallpaper or loose paint must be removed, and repairs made. Priming or backer board may be needed.
